# Credits and licensing

**Everything in this directory was generated by the scripts in
`packages/assets-placeholder/scripts/`.** Nothing was downloaded, sampled,
scanned, captured, traced or derived from third-party content, so there is no
upstream licence to honour and no attribution to carry.

| File                   | Generator       | How it was made                                                     |
| ---------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `arena.spz`            | `gen-arena.mjs` | Gaussians scattered over analytic planes, boxes, a wedge and a dome |
| `arena.collider.bin`   | `gen-arena.mjs` | The same analytic solids, as a triangle mesh                        |
| `arena.spawns.json`    | `gen-arena.mjs` | Coordinates computed from the arena dimensions                      |
| `shot.wav`             | `gen-sfx.mjs`   | Oscillators and seeded pseudo-random noise                          |
| `hit.wav`              | `gen-sfx.mjs`   | Oscillators and seeded pseudo-random noise                          |
| `pickup.wav`           | `gen-sfx.mjs`   | Sine partials, an A-major arpeggio                                  |
| `step.wav`             | `gen-sfx.mjs`   | Oscillators and seeded pseudo-random noise                          |
| `face_idle.arkit.json` | `gen-face.mjs`  | Hand-authored ARKit-52 curves evaluated at 30 fps                   |
| `assets.json`          | hand-written    | The manifest; it is configuration, not content                      |

The generators use only the Node standard library (`node:fs`, `node:url`,
`node:zlib`). They are seeded, so re-running them reproduces the committed bytes
byte for byte:

```sh
npm run generate -w packages/assets-placeholder
git diff --stat -- packages/assets-placeholder/assets
```

## Adding something here

Don't, unless a script can make it. `AGENTS.md` rule 14 caps this package at
12 MB and restricts it to CC0-only content; the simplest way to stay inside both
rules is for every byte to have been computed here. Anything with an attribution
requirement — anything from a marketplace, a scan library or a model zoo —
belongs in the game's own asset directory or in the AvatarOS Asset Manager.
